  FROM omop.drug_era

  GROUP BY person_id
), eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.person_id, e.index_date, e.drug_class
  FROM exposures e
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id=e.person_id
    AND op.observation_period_start_date <= CAST(e.index_date AS date)
    AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day,365,CAST(e.index_date AS date))
  JOIN omop.condition_era ce_s ON ce_s.person_id=e.person_id
    AND ce_s.condition_concept_id IN (436071,437243,435236,4100366,441538,440368,436385,436944,436673,435218,441835,435782,4105330,4194671)
    AND ce_s.condition_era_start_date <= e.index_date
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_era ce_prior ON ce_prior.person_id=e.person_id
    AND ce_prior.condition_concept_id IN (4248716,374013)
    AND ce_prior.condition_era_start_date < e.index_date
  WHERE ce_prior.person_id IS NULL
), outcome_flags AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, e.drug_class, MAX(CASE WHEN ce_out.person_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS has_parkinsonism_12mo
  FROM eligible e
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_era ce_out ON ce_out.person_id=e.person_id
    AND ce_out.condition_concept_id IN (4248716,374013)
    AND ce_out.condition_era_start_date >= e.index_date
    AND ce_out.condition_era_start_date < DATEADD(day,365,e.index_date)
  GROUP BY e.person_id, e.drug_class
)
SELECT drug_class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_exposed,
       SUM(has_parkinsonism_12mo) AS n_parkinsonism_12mo,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(has_parkinsonism_12mo) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS pct_parkinsonism_12mo

No. In this OMOP EHR query, typical antipsychotics did **not** have higher 12-month parkinsonism rates among patients with chronic schizophrenia.

| Class | N exposed | 12-mo parkinsonism | Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Atypical | 272 | 2 | 0.74% |
| Typical | 163 | 0 | 0.00% |

Interpretation: the observed rate was higher in the atypical group, but events were very rare, so this should be treated cautiously and not as strong evidence of a true protective effect of typical antipsychotics.

Caveats: I used OMOP drug eras, chronic schizophrenia condition eras, excluded prior parkinsonism, required 365 days follow-up, and counted new parkinsonism/secondary parkinsonism eras within 12 months. No confounding adjustment or drug exclusivity was applied.
